preprocessing.resample: not required; every prescribed WAV must be mono PCM16 at exactly 16000 Hz or acquisition fails
preprocessing.normalization: truncate or zero-pad each prescribed file to 16000 samples
preprocessing.window: 480-sample Hann Q15, 320-sample stride, committed integer coefficients
preprocessing.fft: 512-point radix-2 decimation-in-time Q15 with one-bit stage scaling
preprocessing.mfcc: 10x10 committed DCT-II Q15 table followed by the checkpoint's frozen integer normalization lookup

model.quantization: signed INT8 activations and weights, INT32 biases/logits, Q24 integer requantization
model.referenceRelationship: The layer family and 49x10 input follow MLPerf Tiny keyword-spotting methodology; the 8-channel checkpoint is independently trained and licensed by this project. No MLPerf weights are represented as this checkpoint.

accuracy.corpus: Speech Commands v2 published test archive, deterministic per-label last-80 holdout
accuracy.claimScope: reproducibility evidence only; this noncanonical split is not an MLPerf submission or upstream 92 percent reference-model claim

numericPolicy.crossTarget: exact integer equality for every normalized feature, every class logit and every stable detection
numericPolicy.idealReference: executed complete output hashes plus direct boundary checks; no tolerance is needed for controlled integer targets

audioScheduling: excluded from controlled compute; any AudioWorklet or real-time schedule is a separately named future variant
